svg.title: The 2023 Bohemia public-authority bargain: two concessions and a later revenue transfer
svg.desc: Evidence schematic based on November 16, 2023 Southeast Louisiana Flood Protection Authority–East board minutes. Lakefront Management Authority agreed not to seek Bohemia revenues received by the flood authority before 2024; the flood authority agreed to forgive an interagency balance. Effective January 1, 2024, future Bohemia revenue was to be routed to LMA. The minutes report revenue figures and a legal settlement escrow closure, but this figure does not establish any payment to a historical claimant or the exact amount forgiven.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios Investigations | Created: 2026-11-17 | License: Copyright 2026 Final Vestige Studios, all rights reserved | Type: original evidence-diagram vector artwork (not an archival photograph or AI historical reconstruction) | Primary source: https://www.floodauthority.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/2023-11-16-SLFPA-E-Board-Meeting-Minutes.pdf (printed pp. 8-9) | Alt text: Two columns show LMA agreeing not to seek pre-2024 Bohemia revenues from FPA, and FPA agreeing to forgive a balance owed by LMA; future Bohemia revenue to LMA from January 1, 2024. A caveat states public-agency concessions are not documented private-heir payments. | Caption: November 2023 FPA–East board minutes record two offsetting interagency concessions, not claimant-level restitution. The FPA board approved the revised MOU and authorized signature; the signed instrument and underlying ledgers have not been examined.
svg.text: Future Bohemia revenues to LMA, as recorded in minutes
NOT PROOF OF A PAYMENT TO AN HEIR
The executed MOU, account journals and beneficiary receipts remain unverified.
Source: FPA–East board minutes, 16 Nov 2023, pp. 8–9 · © 2026 Final Vestige Studios
